story.titleZh: 庆祝2026年FIA世界耐力锦标赛巴塞罗那6小时赛幕后英雄
story.summaryZh: 庆祝281名志愿者和官员的激情、奉献和团队合作，使2026年FIA世界耐力锦标赛倒数第二轮赛事取得成功。
story.originalTitle: Behind every great race, is an incredible team. 🇪🇸 Join us as we celebrate the 281 volunteers and officials whose passion, dedication and teamwo...
story.summaryEn:
Behind every great race, is an incredible team. 🇪🇸
Join us as we celebrate the 281 volunteers and officials whose passion, dedication and teamwork helped make the penultimate round of the 2026 FIA World Endurance Championship a success 👏👏
From behind the scenes to the heart of the action, every contribution mattered. Your commitment brought the event to life and helped create a weekend to remember.
Thank you for being the driving force behind FIA WEC 6 Hours of Barcelona 🤝🙌
#FIA #FIAVolunteersAndOfficials
detailZh:
在每一场伟大的赛事背后，都有一个不可思议的团队。 🇪🇸
随着我们一起庆祝那些281名志愿者和官员，他们的热情、奉献和团队合作使得2026年FIA世界耐力锦标赛的最后一轮赛事取得成功 👏👏
从幕后到赛事的核心，每一份贡献都至关重要。你们的承诺让赛事生动起来，帮助创造了一个难忘的周末。
感谢你们成为FIA WEC巴塞罗那6小时赛事的推动力量 🤝🙌
#FIA #FIAVolunteersAndOfficials
